recommended_ai_agents.name: Lyro by Tidio
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: AI agent for Shopify stores that handles order status, returns, and product questions. Critically for adoption risk, Lyro trains on your existing FAQ and knowledge base in under 10 minutes and improves from human agent responses — meaning staff see it as a tool that learns from them rather than replacing them. Smart escalation to human agents when needed.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Gorgias AI Agent (human-in-the-loop mode)
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Gorgias's 2026 update introduced configurable human oversight controls — the AI drafts responses and flags them for human review before sending for defined categories (size advice, refund decisions, complaints). This is the practical implementation of hallucination risk mitigation for a fashion SME's customer service stack.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Iubenda (AI processing disclosure)
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Iubenda's AI processing disclosure templates specifically cover the UK AI Bill 2026 transparency requirements — informing customers when AI is used in decisions affecting them. For fashion SMEs deploying sizing or recommendation AI, this is the lowest-cost path to meeting transparency obligations.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Prediko
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: AI-powered inventory forecasting for Shopify brands. Provides accurate stock predictions, automated purchase order recommendations, real-time restock alerts, and inventory reports. Reduces overstock and stockout through data-driven buying decisions.
